'''Yuan Quan''' ({{zh|s=袁权}}; 2 November 1934 – 29 October 2023) was a Chinese chemist who was director of the Dalian Institute of Chemical Physics from 1986 to 1994, and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].

He was a representative of the [[14th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party]].<ref name="Ming">{{cite news |url=https://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2023/10/511369.shtm |script-title=zh:著名工程化学家袁权院士逝世，享年90岁 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=31 October 2023 |access-date=11 February 2024 |language=zh}}</ref> 

==Biography==
Yuan was born in [[Shanghai]], on 2 November 1934, while his [[Ancestral home (Chinese)|ancestral home]] in [[Deqing County, Zhejiang|Deqing County]], [[Zhejiang]].<ref name="Ming"/> He graduated from [[Zhejiang University]] majoring in [[chemical engineering]] before gaining a master's degree from the Institute of Petroleum, [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (now Dalian Institute of Chemical Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences).<ref name="Ming"/>

After graduating in 1960, he stayed for researching.<ref name="Ming"/> In November 1978, he became a visiting scholar at [[Stanford University]]. In 1986 he was promoted to become director of the Dalian Institute of Chemical Physics, a position he held until 1994.<ref name="Ming"/>

On 29 October 2023, he died of an illness in [[Dalian]], [[Liaoning]], at the age of 88.<ref name="Ming"/><ref name="Qing">{{cite news |url=https://new.qq.com/rain/a/20231029A0777300 |script-title=zh:中国科学院院士、著名工程化学家袁权逝世，享年90岁 |work=qq.com |date=29 October 2023 |access-date=11 February 2024 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
* 1991 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)<ref name="Ming"/>
* 2001 State Technological Invention Award (Second Class) for a high sulfur capacity impregnated activated carbon dry desulfurization agent and its application.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.most.gov.cn/cxfw/kjjlcx/kjjl2001/200802/t20080214_59033.html |script-title=zh:2001年度国家技术发明奖目录 |work=most.gov.cn |date=5 January 2006 |access-date=11 February 2024 |language=zh |archive-date=14 December 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221214132848/https://www.most.gov.cn/cxfw/kjjlcx/kjjl2001/200802/t20080214_59033.html |url-status=live }}</ref>
* 2001 Science and Technology Progress Award of the [[Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation]]<ref name="Qing"/>
